def bucket():

    bucket_name = f"tmp-{uuid.uuid4().hex}"

    yield bucket

    # Teardown. We're occasionally seeing 409 conflict errors.
    # Retrying upon 409s.
    @backoff.on_exception(backoff.expo, Conflict, max_time=120)
    def delete_bucket():
        bucket.delete(force=True)

    delete_bucket()
